description: The line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” across four different model-benchmark combinations as a function of an increasing x-axis value ranging from 128 to 1024, likely representing context length or input size. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” spans from 0.0 to 0.5 in linear scale, with major ticks at intervals of 0.1. The x-axis is also linear, with labeled ticks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024. Four distinct lines are plotted: (1) LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line) starts at ~0.23 at x=128, rises to ~0.26 at x=256, then plateaus near 0.35 from x=512 to x=1024; (2) Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line) begins at ~0.14 at x=128, jumps to ~0.25 at x=256, then stabilizes at ~0.42 from x=512 to x=1024; (3) LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line) starts low at ~0.07 at x=128, rises sharply to ~0.24 at x=256, then increases more gradually to ~0.38 at x=1024; (4) Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line) begins at ~0.25 at x=128, rises to ~0.27 at x=256, then climbs steadily to ~0.52 at x=1024. All lines show an overall increasing trend with context length, with Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the steepest growth and highest final value.
